settings.name: OIDF_AUTHORITY_ENTITY_ID
settings.description: This authority's Entity Identifier; hosted agents are <id>/federation/agents/<slug> and resources <id>/federation/resources/<slug>; unset, it hosts nothing

when_wrong.detail: Unset: /federation/agents fails on its first request

settings.name: OIDF_AUTHORITY_ADMIN_TOKEN
settings.description: The development static bearer: in the development profile, a request presenting exactly this token as Authorization: Bearer (compared in constant time) is let through any operator route - /federation/admin/*, hosted-entity enrolment and revocation, /federation/registered-clients, and (from the system property or the environment, never an init-param) /agentic-identity/health and /agentic-identity/info - beside PingFederate-issued access tokens, with a WARN per request that names the route. Production never accepts it, and while it is set every operator request is a 503 and the operator API component is REFUSED with a reason that says to remove it (Phase 3 decision 20); operators use PingFederate access tokens there (docs/operator/operator-authentication.md)

when_wrong.detail: Set in production: every operator request is a 503 until it is removed. Wrong in development: the request goes on to the access-token check, and counts against the failed-authentication limit when that refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_URL
settings.description: A direct database for hosted agents, Trust Mark grants and the key history, for development; wins over the data store

when_wrong.detail: Driver missing: hosting is not configured, and with Trust Mark types or key history on PingFederate does not start. Wrong credentials: first use
Wrong: the first use of the store fails

settings.name: OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_PASSWORD
settings.description: The password for OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_URL, or read from the file OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_PASSWORD_FILE names

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: the first use of the store fails

settings.name: OIDF_AUTHORITY_DATA_STORE_ID
settings.description: A PingFederate JDBC data store whose pool the authority's stores use; with neither this nor a JDBC URL everything is in memory, with a warning, and gone at the next restart

when_wrong.detail: An unknown id: the first use of the store fails

settings.name: openBaoUrl
settings.description: OpenBao's address for hosted agents' signing keys, on this servlet; unset, OIDF_OPENBAO_URL and its fallbacks (hosted-entity-signing)

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: a hosted agent's configuration answers 500

settings.name: openBaoToken
settings.description: The OpenBao token, on this servlet; unset, OIDF_OPENBAO_TOKEN and its fallbacks

when_wrong.detail: Refused: a hosted agent's configuration answers 500
